answer: Locks are recorded in hollow, expire in trellis, and zenith lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 12 aliases thus needs 14 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1131 identities would post 3069 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
